name: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker (DLC)
name_original: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker (DLC)
description:
Embark on a circus-themed post-game adventure, where the Solstice Warriors will need to play by foreign rules in order to defeat their evil twins.

Throes of the Watchmaker sends Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale on a side-adventure into the miniature, clockwork world of Horloge, where a cursed carnival threatens its innocent denizens. To survive, they’ll need to play by unfamiliar rules and confront not only the mischievous Puppeteer and her minions, but also their own darker traits.

  • Over 8 hours of completely new Areas, Music, Dungeons, Mini-Games, Enemies, Bosses, and Puzzles.
  • New Playable Classes - Playing to the circus-themed curse, Solstice Warriors will unlock a completely new set of attacks, damage types, skills and combos.
  • New Playable Character - Arty joins the party! The friendly engineer robot will finally unlock the laser-shooting capabilities of his construct.
  • Couch Co-Op With Up To 3 Players - Allows up to three players to engage in traversal and combat.
